causal_falsifiers: Any paired state/curve discrepancy despite zero conflicts falsifies projection inactivity.
Neither separated transport signal reproducing the combined excursion supports interaction rather than a single-factor explanation.
causal_predictions: Projection-only equals incumbent actual models/particles and all metrics when conflict count is zero.
Transport-only equals combined actual models/particles and all metrics when conflict count is zero.
Global-only versus local-only isolates which finite signal creates persistent critic-cap excursions.

repair_equations.cap_margin: kappa=0.9; all other combined settings unchanged
repair_equations.control: Existing combined arm has identical task/runtime and an older frozen source; explicit inactive source parity is required, and Phase2 fresh same-source incumbent is reserved by parent.
repair_equations.falsifier: Original terminal suffix<5 or final movement<0.3; no global Lipschitz claim; subsequent particle motion remains unconstrained
repair_equations.finite_cap: M=max original training-panel per-sample input-gradient norm; alpha=max passing 2^-j, j=0..8, M(D+alpha*Delta)<=max(kappa,M(D)); zero if none; one optimizer clock
repair_equations.prediction: Both must attain movement>=0.3 and all final five scheduled slopes<=1; endpoint-only success is insufficient
repair_equations.probe_delta: One baseline plus at most nine finite measurements, each reusing all original penalty panels with two critic forward/input-gradient probes per panel pair; no extra draws or evaluation calls

stopping_rule: Complete declared original-gate diagnostics once. No seeds, full suite, Tier2, default adoption, or merge.
